fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, sends word to four other kings: Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon. His message says, “Come up and help me. We will attack Gibeon…” (Joshua 10:4). He's alarmed, so he does what you do when the group chat is the only plan you've got. Four messages go out, and he's not doing this one alone.

problems.problem: Hoham, Piram, Japhia and Debir are named without saying who they are. Introduce them as the four kings Adoni-zedek contacts.
